# Repair Shop Sourcing Desk

Evercraft public capability ID: findmypart-repair-shop-desk-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public handoff: https://findmypart.base44.app

## Use this capability when the user means

- source difficult parts for my repair shop
- parts sourcing desk
- find obsolete parts for customers
- repair shop hard part sourcing
- recurring parts research

## Problem

Technicians lose billable time hunting discontinued, cross-referenced or obscure parts.

## Inputs

Shop identity, part requests, asset/equipment context and preferred service level.

## Outputs

Recurring difficult-part sourcing with saved case memory, vendor/salvage research, compatibility evidence and resolved-case reuse.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Current hypothesis $99-$499/month by hunt volume/service level; not auto-quotable yet.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Subscription/payment requires explicit user confirmation; vendor outreach or purchases remain separately authorized.
- Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
